notes: Entries describe candidate export settings, not verified output file metadata.
Actual exports are not included in this package; HTML/CSS specimens are editable previews.
Platform, printer, page, bleed, color-profile, font-embedding, and physical proof details require destination-specific confirmation.

formats.canvas: Use the source candidate viewBox; preserve source geometry and aspect ratio.
formats.transparentBackground: As supplied by the selected WP04 candidate; inspect each variant.
formats.exportGuidance: Reference the WP04 SVG candidate directly. Do not redraw paths or claim a new logo master.

formats.canvas: Render to destination dimensions at 2x when a high-density screen asset is needed.
formats.resolution: Screen: 1x/2x variants; print placed raster: target 300 ppi at final physical size.
formats.exportGuidance: Keep alpha for logo assets where supported. Check antialiasing and small-size legibility; keep editable SVG as source.

formats.canvas: Export each layout at its design canvas pixel dimensions or larger for review.
formats.transparentBackground: Only where the artwork requires transparency; paper layouts use opaque background.
formats.resolution: Screen preview in sRGB; this is a recommendation, not verified file metadata.
formats.exportGuidance: Retain PROVISIONAL label on review proofs; previews do not establish print color accuracy.

formats.assetType: Business document / letterhead / report / proposal / invoice
formats.canvas: A4 candidate trim 210 × 297 mm; digital page size should follow the recipient or print provider.
formats.resolution: Vector text preferred; raster images 300 ppi at placed size for print guidance.
formats.exportGuidance: Export fonts only when installed and licensing permits embedding. Use printer-specified PDF preset and color profile when provided. No profile or embedding status has been verified.

formats.fileType: SVG or PNG backgrounds; editable slides to be authored in a separately approved tool
formats.transparentBackground: Optional for standalone vector/raster elements; full slide backgrounds are opaque.
formats.resolution: 1920 × 1080 px preview; use vector elements when supported.
formats.exportGuidance: Keep body text and graphics editable; verify projector contrast, crop, and font substitution. No PPTX/PDF deck is included.

formats.canvas: Business card candidate 90 × 50 mm; letterhead A4 candidate; confirm final trim with provider.
formats.resolution: 300 ppi for placed raster; vector logo and text preferred.
formats.exportGuidance: 3 mm bleed and 4 mm card safe margin are starting recommendations only. Obtain the print provider's trim, bleed, color mode, profile, and PDF preset. Physical proof not performed.

canvasPresets.unit: px maximum suggested width; fluid height
